hazards.detail: The road is fair to about the 25th bend, then rough and potholed. Some bends fit one vehicle at a time.

gaps: No official page found that says in words whether motorcycles need the Kodaikanal pass; the pass website lists Kodaikanal and Valparai but its form would not load.
The Dindigul district pages on the Kodaikanal pass and green tax now return an error, so the green tax amount is left out.
No government order found for the Aliyar check post hours; a newspaper and a local guide give 6 pm, a tour operator gives 10 pm.
No official source found for Kolli Hills check post timings or any night closure of the ghat road.
No official source found for an entry fee or toll for two-wheelers at Yercaud, Kolli Hills, Valparai or Kodaikanal.
The Yercaud speed limit comes from a search summary of a newspaper page that could not be opened.
The Namakkal district page gives Kolli Hills as 1,200 metres; the encyclopedia gives 1,300 metres for the highest point.
No source found for the usual number of days riders take, or for fuel on the hill tops.
Hairpin bend counts are added as header.hairpin_bends, which is not in the schema example; the Valparai and Yercaud counts come from the sources on their hazard entries.
Both videos cover Kolli Hills; none kept for Valparai, Yercaud or Kodaikanal. Filming dates are not known.
